d: We are currently seeking passionate and dynamic guest focused Housekeeping professionals who pride themselves on their ability to deliver extraordinary levels of customer service and provide creative solutions to our guests. As an Assistant Housekeeping Manager you are responsible for managing and leading the Housekeeping Team, Department towards achieving the departmental goals and objectives.
q: You should be a college or university graduate with at least three years previous management experience within the Housekeeping Department of a hotel. Technically you will have fluency in both written and spoken English, whereby additional language skills would be a definite benefit and knowledge of Micros and Opera coupled with administration and organizational computer literacy skills is essential.
The ideal candidate will be an exceptionally strong professional with an eye for detail and a passion for high-quality hotel keeping.
You will be self-motivated, flexible and creative in order to develop innovative options in the best interest of guests and the hotel and should possess the following additional competencies
r: li
Ensure the standards of cleanliness and maintenance of the Hotel meet the specified requirements.
li

Monitor cleanliness of guest rooms, with special care for VIP and long stay Guests, and public areas to ensure compliance to the Leading Quality Assurance standards of the Hotel and monitor the release of rooms to avoid delays during check-in.
li
Investigate and attend to Guest complaints in a timely manner and follow up effectively to ensure Guest satisfaction.
li
Coordinate and monitor Preventive Maintenance Program and Spring Cleaning progress in both rooms and public areas to upkeep the properties equipment, image and upholstery.
li
Carry out the Employee Development related requirements for new joiners to ensure they settle in quickly.
li

Provide effective feedback, corrective coaching and counselling to employees based on employee performance and communicates any gross misconduct or disciplinary actions to the Department Head in order to bring the Employee back on the right track.
li

Assist Director of Housekeeping and Assistant Director of Housekeeping with the Performance Management process activities i.e. setting of KJRs, conducting Mid Year Reviews and APR to enhance performance.
li
Prepare the roster for employees directly reporting to them and clear pending days, annual leave and public holidays to ensure effective operation.
li

Maintain a safe and hazard free environment for Guests and employees by communicating any faulty equipment or dangerous situations to the Engineering, Security Department and open the safety box of check-out, vacant rooms to ensure safety of Guest belongings.
li
Operate in a safe and environmentally friendly way to protect guests' and employees' health and safety, as well as protect and conserve the environment.
li
Comply with the hotel environmental, health and safety policies and procedures.
